speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned waking up frightened; can you tell me if you dream vividly or if you have been seeing or hearing things while asleep? Also, do you ever feel like your limbs are stuck or have a strange sensation upon waking?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terror Disorder (Sleep Terrors)

I have noted that she wakes frightened, cries, and is consolable without confusion, which fits your description. Do you observe any specific physical movements like thrashing or screaming during these episodes? REQUEST TEST: Sleep_Study (Polysomnography)
